page.notes: Uncertain readings: the Hebrew at "Rex noster", "Messiam" and "adducturus" (צֶדֶק עוֹלָמִים), the Greek at Luke 2:40,49 (ἐν τοῖς [?] τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ) and the final Greek phrase (τὴν δόξαν … αὐτοῦ) are copied from a small, soft scan and should be checked against the original. The reference "1.Cor.11,30." is copied as printed. The underlined "Quemadmodum" is plain in the transcription. The long s is written as s throughout.
